lines.text: It looks like a gift.
lines.caption: It looks like a gift.

lines.text: OpenAI says more than a billion people use it every week. The vast majority pay nothing.
lines.caption: OpenAI says more than 1 billion people use it every week. The vast majority pay nothing.

lines.text: So what are you paying with?
lines.caption: So what are you paying with?

lines.text: November thirtieth, twenty twenty-two. ChatGPT launches, free.
lines.caption: November 30, 2022. ChatGPT launches, free.

lines.text: Critics called it unreliable. A million users came in five days.
lines.caption: Critics called it unreliable. A million users came in 5 days.

lines.text: Why free? OpenAI's launch post says: to get users' feedback.
lines.caption: Why free? OpenAI's launch post says: "to get users' feedback."

lines.text: And the next model, GPT-4, had already finished training. Three months before you said hello.
lines.caption: And the next model, GPT-4, had already finished training. Three months before you said hello.

lines.text: Scale built it: bigger models, more data, more compute, predictably better.
lines.caption: Scale built it: bigger models, more data, more compute, predictably better.

lines.text: Then OpenAI refined it, partly with feedback submitted by ChatGPT users.
lines.caption: Then OpenAI refined it, partly with "feedback submitted by ChatGPT users."

lines.text: The free product was shaping the next one.
lines.caption: The free product was shaping the next one.

lines.text: It has a name: the data flywheel.
lines.caption: It has a name: the data flywheel.

lines.text: You use it. Your feedback becomes signal. The model improves. More people come.
lines.caption: You use it. Your feedback becomes signal. The model improves. More people come.

lines.text: OpenAI said thumbs-up and thumbs-down data from ChatGPT became a reward signal.
lines.caption: OpenAI said "thumbs-up and thumbs-down data from ChatGPT" became a reward signal.

lines.text: It helped make the model so flattering that OpenAI rolled the update back. Your clicks steer it.
lines.caption: It helped make the model so flattering that OpenAI rolled the update back. Your clicks steer it.

lines.text: You're not just the customer. You're part of the wheel.
lines.caption: You're not just the customer. You're part of the wheel.

lines.text: Startups rush to wrap the models.
lines.caption: Startups rush to wrap the models.

lines.text: Then ChatGPT learned to read PDFs. One reaction: many startups just died today.
lines.caption: Then ChatGPT learned to read PDFs. One reaction: "Many startups just died today."

lines.text: Sam Altman's warning: bet that the models won't improve, and you'll get steamrolled.
lines.caption: Sam Altman's warning: bet that the models won't improve, and you'll get "steamrolled."

lines.text: Each model opens doors. The next release can close them.
lines.caption: Each model opens doors. The next release can close them.

lines.text: The wheel reaches the coders.
lines.caption: The wheel reaches the coders.

lines.text: Big employers made it official: use AI.
lines.caption: Big employers made it official: use AI.

lines.text: In twenty twenty-three, AI could solve two percent of real GitHub issues on a benchmark.
lines.caption: In 2023, AI could solve 2% of real GitHub issues on a benchmark.

lines.text: By February twenty twenty-six, Anthropic reported about eighty percent for Claude Opus four point six.
lines.caption: By February 2026, Anthropic reported about 80% for Claude Opus 4.6.

lines.text: Then Claude Opus five point five, which Anthropic puts at the level of its bigger Fable model on most work.
lines.caption: Then Claude Opus 5.5, which Anthropic puts at the level of its bigger Fable model on most work.

lines.text: On personal plans, your code can feed the wheel too. In GitHub's words: real-world data equals smarter models.
lines.caption: On personal plans, your code can feed the wheel too. In GitHub's words: "Real-world data = smarter models."

lines.text: So why is it nearly free?
lines.caption: So why is it nearly free?

lines.text: Investor billions. A race for users. Ads. Falling costs.
lines.caption: Investor billions. A race for users. Ads. Falling costs.

lines.text: And part of the price is paid in data. Yours.
lines.caption: And part of the price is paid in data. Yours.

lines.text: You can switch it off. Most people never touch their defaults.
lines.caption: You can switch it off. Most people never touch their defaults.

lines.text: It's a trade, and often a good one.
lines.caption: It's a trade, and often a good one.

lines.text: But if your plan is a thin wrapper around someone else's model, please, wait. The wheel won't.
lines.caption: But if your plan is a thin wrapper around someone else's model, please, wait. The wheel won't.

lines.text: Still, go ahead. Build. Raise money. Ship.
lines.caption: Still, go ahead. Build. Raise money. Ship.

lines.text: But your biggest asset is not on that list.
lines.caption: But your biggest asset is not on that list.

lines.text: Your attention. We now stay on one screen about forty-seven seconds before switching. Guard it.
lines.caption: Your attention. We now stay on one screen about 47 seconds before switching. Guard it.

lines.text: Your mind. In Anthropic's own trial, coders learning with AI scored seventeen points lower on what they'd just learned. Train it.
lines.caption: Your mind. In Anthropic's own trial, coders learning with AI scored 17 points lower on what they'd just learned. Train it.

lines.text: Your body, and your mental health. People who exercise report forty-three percent fewer bad mental-health days. Move it.
lines.caption: Your body, and your mental health. People who exercise report 43% fewer bad mental-health days. Move it.

lines.text: No release will update you. Only you can.
lines.caption: No release will update you. Only you can.

lines.text: Invest consciously.
